description: A 38kHz infrared receiver — decodes IR remote signals (or direct NEC-encoded commands sent through the simulator UI) into a digital output.
how_to_use: VCC/GND power, DAT is a digital output the microcontroller reads (decoded with an IR-remote library, not raw digitalRead logic).

plain.what: Picks up the invisible signals from a TV remote.
plain.how: Three legs: signal to an Arduino pin, GND and 5V. The IRremote library tells you which button was pressed.
